people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
translations.bsb: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!”
translations.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
translations.asv: The same following after Paul and us cried out, saying, These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim unto you the way of salvation.
